name: sheet-merge-split
description: Combine many Excel/CSV files — and every sheet inside a workbook — into one table, even when their columns are named differently (日期/Date, 金额/Amount (元)), with a column showing where each row came from. Or split one table into a sheet or a file per store, region, person or any other column. Missing columns are reported, numbers stay numbers. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Combine many Excel/CSV files — and every sheet inside a workbook — into one table, even when their columns are named differently (日期/Date, 金额/Amount (元)), with a column showing where each row came from. Or split one table into a sheet or a file per store, region, person or any other column. Missing columns are reported, numbers stay numbers. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把很多个 Excel/CSV 文件——连同工作簿里的每个工作表——合并成一张表，列名不一样也能对齐（日期/Date、金额/Amount (元)），并加一列记录每行来自哪里。也可以把一张表按门店、地区、负责人等任意列拆成多个工作表或多个文件。缺少的列会提示，数字保持数字格式。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
